mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_event (id, event_type, recipient_id, actor_id, resource_id, summary) VALUES (#{id}, #{eventType}, #{recipientId}, #{actorId}, #{resourceId}, #{summary})
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET status='DEAD', claim_token=NULL, lease_until=NULL, last_error='lease-exhausted-unconfirmed' WHERE status='IN_FLIGHT' AND lease_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND attempts >= 10 ORDER BY lease_until, id LIMIT 100

UPDATE outbox_event SET status = 'IN_FLIGHT', claim_token = #{token}, lease_until = DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL 60 SECOND), attempts = attempts + 1, total_attempts = total_attempts + 1 WHERE attempts < 10 AND ((status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY') AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) OR (status = 'IN_FLIGHT' AND lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))) ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT #{batchSize}
UPDATE outbox_event SET status = 'SENT', sent_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), claim_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'IN_FLIGHT' AND claim_token = #{token}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outbox_event WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY', 'IN_FLIGHT')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outbox_event WHERE status = 'DEAD'
SELECT COALESCE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, MIN(created_at), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)), 0) FROM outbox_event WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY', 'IN_FLIGHT')
